summary: Fayette County tower with a watchman on duty by October 1921; the Forest Lookouts listing dates its removal to 1979.

facts.status_note: The Forest Lookouts listing gives 1979 as the year the tower was removed.

events.note: A watchman was on duty continuously at the new tower, according to an October 1921 newspaper report quoted on the Forest Lookouts page.
The watchman spotted a brush-heap fire about ten miles from the tower and alerted the fire wardens.
The Forest Lookouts listing gives 1979 as the year of removal. It gives no reason.

evidence.supports: Tower is in Fayette County, Pennsylvania
October 1921 newspaper calls the tower new and says it views nearly three-fourths of the county's forestry area
evidence.quote: Value of the new forest fire tower on Sugar Loaf mountain, which gives a view of nearly three-fourths of the forestry area of Fayette county

evidence.supports: Watchman on duty continuously, living in a cabin at the foot of the tower
evidence.quote: A watchman is on duty continuously at the new tower, living quarters being provided in a cabin at the foot of the tower.

evidence.supports: Four-mile telephone extension to the tower
evidence.quote: Telephone communication with the tower had been established by a four mile extension of telephone lines direct to the tower.

evidence.supports: Watchman detected smoke from a brush-heap fire and notified the fire wardens
evidence.quote: The watchman at the tower detected the smoke and immediately notified the fire wardens

evidence.supports: Fire started in a brush heap about ten miles from the tower
evidence.quote: a fire which had started in a brush heap some ten miles from the tower

evidence.supports: Fire wardens located the fire immediately after it started
evidence.quote: fire wardens immediately located the fire

evidence.supports: Listing gives 1979 as the removal year
TopoQuest places the Sugarloaf Fire Tower in Fayette County at 2,923 feet elevation
evidence.quote: Sugarloaf Fire Tower is a tower located in Fayette County, PA at N39.832021° W79.434482° (WGS84/NAD83) and at an elevation of 2923 ft MSL.

evidence.supports: TopoQuest places the tower on the USGS Ohiopyle, PA map sheet
evidence.quote: It can be seen on the USGS 1:24K topographic map Ohiopyle, PA

corrections.why: TopoQuest places the tower in Fayette County at N39.832021, W79.434482. The brief's point is roughly 300 km from that location, so it cannot be inside the county the brief names.

notes_for_editor: Two sources. The Forest Lookouts page carries the October 1921 Morning Herald item and the 1979 removal line, and TopoQuest gives the Fayette County location. The brief's coordinates do not match Fayette County, so a correction is proposed. The Wikipedia article on Sugarloaf Knob (Ohiopyle State Park) does not mention the tower, and its listed point is roughly 2.5 km from the TopoQuest point; it is not used. Two WebSearch calls and three page reads turned up no build year, design, height, agency or access record, so the story gives none. Editor should confirm the correction against a second map source before publishing.
